recognize_zh: 三個分圖中的母細胞核質比高、細胞質少，但一端延伸出淡藍色的細胞質尾巴 (uropod)，使細胞呈不對稱的「手鏡形」(hand-mirror cell)；此為急性淋巴母細胞白血病的形態變異，本例為 T-ALL。
features: Medium-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio and round to mildly irregular nuclear contours
Moderately condensed to finely granular chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Cytoplasm scant and basophilic, concentrated at one pole as a pale blue tail-like projection (uropod), producing a hand-mirror shape
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods in the blasts
Panel C also shows a mature neutrophil for size comparison
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows medium-to-large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei, granular chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Many blasts display polarized, lightly basophilic cytoplasm drawn out into a single tail-like projection, giving a hand-mirror configuration. Cytoplasmic granules and Auer rods are absent. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia with hand-mirror cell morphology; lineage assignment (T-lineage in this case) requires flow cytometry, as hand-mirror morphology has no independent lineage or prognostic significance.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with hand-mirror blasts
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts may also form uropods but usually show nucleoli, fine granules or Auer rods and are MPO positive.
Monoblasts have more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, folded nuclei and are nonspecific esterase positive.
B-ALL can look identical including hand-mirror forms, so separation depends on cytoplasmic CD3 (T-ALL) versus CD19/CD79a (B-ALL) by flow cytometry.
Hematogones are smaller with homogeneous condensed chromatin, show a maturation continuum on flow and lack aberrant antigen expression.
